question: Why can even a wise person be afflicted despite contact with the nectar's essence?
premises: There is contact with the tip of nectar
There is burning by the essence of juice
Even a wise person can be affected
inference: Even the wise may suffer burning when exposed to the potent essence at the tip of nectar.
uncertainties: The physiological or yogic referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are not explicit.
plain_english: Even a wise person may be burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
